h1: Study Confirms That MedSpa Treatment Prevents and Delays Signs of Aging

blocks.html: Standford University has a new 10-year study on the effectiveness of BBL (broadband light) Photofacials. The study actually concluded that patients who receive 2-3 BBL Photofacials every year can reverse signs of aging and “prevent” future aging as well. In the photos of the study participants, many had younger-looking, smoother and more even-toned skin even a decade later than when they began treatments. In fact, the study showed that 2-3 Photofacial treatments per year can help restore the gene expression of aged skin to resemble much younger skin. The patients in the study showed more uniform collagen deposits as well as decreased elastosis which lead to improvements in fine lines and pigmentation.
We have seen these kinds of results at Victory MedSpa as patients seek BBL Photofacial services to help remove sun damaged skin, broken capillaries, and improve skin texture and tone.
Photofacials can eliminate a variety of skin issues including:

items: Age spots
Uneven skin tone/texture
Freckles
Sunspots
Brown Spots
Redness
Broken Capillaries
Rosacea
